See bd-01KZXWPKT4XPSB55PB5RBSAZRT before running the gate for record. The harness is good; the fixture is statistically degenerate. Measured on the exact geometry: 52416 voxels (target hit), supports median 33, but observations=32 with 2 design columns gives 30 residual df, and 3 partitions under exclude_evaluation leaves ONE training run per edge. Result: 83.9% of supports have k > df, so the local covariance is singular before shrinkage, and 99.9% exceed df/2. shrinkage_precision(0.2) is supplying the estimate rather than regularizing one.

The timing and memory numbers remain valid as linear-algebra cost, but this epic acceptance is about establishing the ACTUAL supported regime, and as configured the gate would certify brain-scale dense local metrics using a fixture where no searchlight has enough data to estimate one. It is also the exact data-starved corner that produced the largest metric bias in the Epic 7 study.

Fix is cheap - observations 32 -> 200 (198 df), or partitions 3 -> 6 (120 df, df/k ~ 3.6). Raising observations costs simulation time only, not gate runtime, since residual statistics accumulate once per partition. Also worth emitting the realised df-to-support ratio in the gate output so the artifact states its regime.
